{{Quote|Yeah.|A pirate|<ref name="SC 106" />}}
A [[Gender|male]]<ref name="SC 106 SBT" /> '''pirate''' was affiliated with a [[Silvo's pirates|crew]] led by [[Captain]] [[Brutus]] during the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="SC 106" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> the man attended the [[Trial of Silvo|trial]] of former Captain [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]]. During his [[Right of Last Appeal|last appeal]], Silvo asked the spectators to imagine a [[Planet|world]] where they would not need to worry about being short on [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]], alluding to the planet [[At Attin]]. The male pirate reacted to this vision with a resonant sigh of approbation. In the end, Silvo's life was conditionally spared for the time being, regardless of the [[Death penalty|death sentence]] he had previously heard.<ref name="SC 106" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Gender|male]] [[pirate]] was first heard in "[[Zero Friends Again]]," the sixth episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'',<ref name="SC 106" /> released on [[December 31]], [[2024]].<ref name="Premiere">{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}}</ref>
